in_arabic.name: Landa
in_arabic.long_meaning: Landa هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'land', meaning 'to rest', 'to be at ease'. In Islamic tradition, Landa signifies the tranquility and grace bestowed by Allah upon His beloved creatures.
